## Overview

**Gold Price Forecasting** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Time-series gold price forecasts with ARIMA-style models.

## Background & Motivation

Standalone notebook **Gold Price forecasting.ipynb** in collection root—PDS time-series module.

Gold acts as a macro hedge in emerging markets; short-term forecasts support coursework in time-series methods.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

- Load historical gold price series
- Test stationarity; difference if needed
- Fit ARIMA/ETS (or comparable) models
- Plot forecasts with confidence intervals
- Interpret limitations (macro shocks, non-stationarity)

## Data Collection & Preparation

Historical gold price time series (public market data in notebook).

## Methodology & Analysis

Classical time-series EDA; ARIMA-style modeling; forecast visualization.

## Model Evaluation

In-sample vs. out-of-sample forecast error; residual diagnostics.

## Results & Key Learnings

Forecast notebook suitable for PDS time-series grading rubric.
